title: 第十七章 帝都来的贵公子们第十八章 诸位再见了
content_zh:
许清清看着人群中的罗冠，他明明喝的最多，却始终眼神明亮，不见半点醉意。罗冠他什么时候有了这么好的酒量？面对负气几人，始终言谈从容，举止沉稳大度，有种难言的魅力。
许清清很沮丧，突然觉得自己，一点也不了解他。今天，是她拜托罗宁一定把罗冠请来，可心里的那些话，现在却一句都说不出来。
沐颜不断看向罗宁，每当他大笑豪饮时，便眼波流转。
胡珊拉住她们，大声嚷嚷，“一群臭男人，有什么好看的，咱们喝！”她对罗冠，更加不顺眼了。
刚才居然直接道歉，让她不得不承认，这家伙有点气度。而且，罗冠的酒量，貌似比她胡大丫还能喝，我就不服！
许清清有心事，跟胡珊一杯又一杯的喝，沐颜苦笑作陪。
胡珊彻底喝多了，冲进男人战场，一脚踩在椅子上，露出一截洁白如玉的长腿。
气势豪放！
“清清别喝了，你没事吧？”沐颜还算清醒，按住酒杯。
许清清摇晃起身，“我洗把脸……”
沐颜道：“我陪你。”
两人出了包厢，三楼洗手间外，一群醉汉肩膀拍的震天响，拍着拍着一人就吐了。
有了刺激，其他几个也压不住，转眼瀑布滚滚，腥臭一片。
两女皱眉止步。
沐颜道：“我扶你去四楼。”这很安静，居然像是没什么客人，两人从洗手间出来。
沐颜突然捂住嘴，“清清你等我下！”她没喝多，最近肠胃不太好。
许清清迷迷糊糊，摇晃起身，用力推开包房。
唰——
几道阴沉眼神，落在她身上。
许清清酒劲一散，“对……不起……走错地方了……”

“拦住她！”
锦袍青年冷喝。
沐颜出来，正好看到这一幕，“你们干什么！”
时间推前片刻。
松涛亭。
刘源态度恭敬，为几人倒茶、端酒。
他是城主嫡子，在江宁城里，说句一人之下万人之上不过分。可这几位，皆是帝都来的贵公子，各有大背景，便是他爹也要以礼相待。
“小刘，坐下吧。”一名贵公子开口，语气随意，“你爹突破冲霄境，不日将被调走，去偏远之地担任郡守，也算一方高官。”
他眼神扫过其他人，“刘郡守，不是外人。”
“我说，你怎么有闲情雅致，跟小刘出来吃饭。”侯斌笑道：“刘宣，你们都姓刘，该不会是远房亲戚吧？”
刘宣淡淡道：“我家只有一门亲戚，就在帝宫里，你不知道？”他摆手，“都别废话了，大家跑来江宁这小地方，目的是一样的，别藏着掖着了。”
他目露精芒，“你们有什么收获？”
“白跑一趟，什么线索都没有。”
“金鼎那边，普通人不知道，有可能接触的，都是金家的亲信。”
“这些人，我试图重金收买，却没有效果。”
content_en:
Xu Qingqing looked at Luo Guan in the crowd. He obviously drank the most, but his eyes were always bright and he was not drunk at all. When did Luo Guan have such a good drinking capacity? In the face of angry people, he always speaks calmly and behaves calmly and generously, which has an indescribable charm.
Xu Qingqing was very frustrated, and suddenly felt that she didn't understand him at all. Today, she asked Luo Ning to invite Luo Guan, but she couldn't say a word of what was in her heart.
Muyan kept looking at Luo Ning, and her eyes would wander every time he laughed and drank heavily.
Hu Shan grabbed them and shouted, "What a bunch of stinky men there are to see, let's drink!" She was even more displeased with Luo Guan.
He actually apologized directly just now, so she had to admit that this guy was a bit magnanimous. Moreover, Luo Guan's drinking capacity seems to be better than that of her Hu Daya, but I don't accept it!
Xu Qingqing had something on her mind, so she drank one cup after another with Hu Shan, accompanied by Mu Yan's wry smile.
Hu Shan was completely drunk, rushed into the men's battlefield, stepped on the chair, revealing a long leg as white as jade.
The momentum is bold and bold!
"Qingqing, please stop drinking. Are you okay?" Muyan was still sober and held down the wine glass.
Xu Qingqing stood up and said, "Let me wash my face..."
Mu Yan said: "I will accompany you."
The two of them came out of the box. Outside the restroom on the third floor, a group of drunk men slapped their shoulders loudly. One of them vomited after slapping them.
With the stimulation, the others couldn't hold it back, and in a blink of an eye, the waterfall was rolling and smelly.
The two women frowned and stopped.
Mu Yan said, "I'll help you to the fourth floor." It was very quiet, as if there were no guests, and the two came out of the bathroom.
Muyan suddenly covered her mouth, "Qingqing, wait for me!" She didn't drink too much, and her stomach and intestines were not feeling well recently.
Xu Qingqing was drowsy, stood up unsteadily, and pushed open the private room with all his strength.
Swish——
Several dark eyes fell on her.
Xu Qingqing's alcoholic energy dissipated, "Sorry... I'm sorry... I went to the wrong place..."
"Stop her!"
The young man in brocade robe shouted coldly.
Muyan came out and happened to see this scene, "What are you doing!"
Time moves forward a moment.
Songtao Pavilion.
Liu Yuan was respectful and poured tea and wine for several people.
He is the legitimate son of the city lord. In Jiangning City, it is not too much to say that one person is inferior to ten thousand people. But these few are all noble sons from the imperial capital, and each has a great background. Even his father must treat each other with courtesy.
"Xiao Liu, sit down." A noble man said in a casual tone, "Your father has broken through to the Sky Realm and will be transferred soon to serve as a county guard in a remote place. He is also considered a high-ranking official."
He glanced at the others, "Governor Liu, not an outsider."
"I asked, why do you have the leisure and elegance to go out to dinner with Xiao Liu?" Hou Bin said with a smile: "Liu Xuan, your surname is Liu, are you distant relatives?"
Liu Xuan said calmly: "I only have one relative in my family, and it's in the imperial palace. Don't you know?" He waved his hand, "Stop talking nonsense. Everyone came to this small place in Jiangning for the same purpose. Stop hiding it."
His eyes sparkled, "What did you gain?"
"It's a waste of time, there are no clues."
"On the other side of Jinding, ordinary people don't know that those who are likely to come into contact are close associates of the Jin family."
"I tried to buy these people with huge sums of money, but it didn't work."
